response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS size FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(size) OVER () AS avg_size FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_above_average_sources, SUM(size) AS combined_size, AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess_over_average_size FROM a WHERE size > avg_size
